ideas.pitch: An offline-first multilingual patient triage and symptom checker designed for rural health camps with low connectivity.
ideas.title: ArogyaSync: Localized Rural Healthcare Triage & Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on practical offline execution and direct community impact, which deeply resonates with local university hackathon judges looking for real-world utility over flashy vapourware.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-localized skill development platform that converts unstructured vocational training videos into interactive quizzes and flashcards in regional languages.
ideas.title: EduSutra: AI-Powered Regional Language Skill Development Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages video intelligence parsing to solve a clear, quantifiable accessibility problem in Indian technical and vocational education.

ideas.pitch: A real-time IoT simulation and tracking dashboard for monitoring campus resource consumption, carbon footprint, and waste segregation bins.
ideas.title: EcoGrid: Smart Campus Energy & Waste Audit Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses institutional sustainability with an instantly demoable live dashboard that judges can interact with on their own devices.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight routing and pricing engine that minimizes post-harvest loss by matching local farmers directly with micro-retailers based on transit time.
ideas.title: KrishiBazaar: Direct Farmer-to-Consumer Produce Logistics Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a massive agrarian pain point with a clear economic benefit model that appeals strongly to RGPV-level regional innovation criteria.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-response web app allowing students to drop pin-based emergency alerts with automated local authority escalation and broadcast capabilities.
ideas.title: SafeCampus: Geofenced Incident Reporting & Emergency Response Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus safety problem with a polished, working emergency trigger UI that impresses judges during live stress-testing.
